from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
import dacite
@dataclass
class TopicLink:
    """
    A TopicLink links two Concepts
    """
    pageTitle:str
    name:Optional[str] # The name of the topic link
    source:Optional[str] # the source of a topic Link
    sourceRole:Optional[str] # None
    sourceMultiple:Optional[bool] # None
    sourceDocumentation:Optional[str] # Documentation for the source Role
    target:Optional[str] # None
    targetRole:Optional[str] # None
    targetMultiple:Optional[bool] # None
    targetDocumentation:Optional[str] # Documentation for the target Role
    separator:Optional[str] # [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Setting_values/Working_with_the_separator_parameter separator parameter] to be used in [https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Setting_values/Working_with_the_separator_parameter SMW #set] - no separator is given subobjects are assumed
    masterDetail:Optional[bool] # should the details be displayed in the same form and template?
If no 
* for a 1:1 link there will be a linking attribute used and that can be selected. 
* for a 1:n link a link to the list of neighbours will be displayed
if yes
* for a 1:1 link the details
* for a 1:n link

    @classmethod
    def askQuery(cls):
        """
        get the ask Query for TopicLink

        Returns:
            str: the mediawiki markup for the ask query
        """
        ask="""{{#ask: [[Concept:TopicLink]]
|mainlabel=pageTitle
|?TopicLink name = name
|?TopicLink source = source
|?TopicLink sourceRole = sourceRole
|?TopicLink sourceMultiple = sourceMultiple
|?TopicLink sourceDocumentation = sourceDocumentation
|?TopicLink target = target
|?TopicLink targetRole = targetRole
|?TopicLink targetMultiple = targetMultiple
|?TopicLink targetDocumentation = targetDocumentation
|?TopicLink separator = separator
|?TopicLink masterDetail = masterDetail
|limit=10000
|format=table
}}"""
        return ask

    @classmethod
    def fromDict(cls,data:dict):
        """
        create a TopicLink from the given dict

        Args:
            data(dict): the dict to create the TopicLink from

        Returns:
            TopicLink: the freshly created TopicLink
        """
        topiclink=dacite.from_dict(data_class=cls,data=data)
        return topiclink
